name: Arkade Developers Ltd
title: Arkade Developers Ltd - 544261 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Mumbai developer with H1 FY27 pre-sales of Rs 306 crore and revenue down sharply YoY; launches slipped to Q3, prior FY27 pre-sales and launch targets still unproven, with no capex or supply discipline data.

triggers.label: H1 pre-sales Rs 306 crore
triggers.quote: Pre-sales for the quarter stood at Rs. 151 crore, with first-half pre-sales at Rs. 306 crore.

triggers.label: Launches slipped to Q3 FY27
triggers.quote: We are targeting the launch of two projects with a combined GDV of approximately Rs. 2,850 crore in Q3 FY27.

triggers.label: Rs 70 crore approval cost in inventory
triggers.quote: for all these projects till date we have incurred about Rs. 70 crores towards the approval cost.

guidance.quote: We are targeting the launch of two projects with a combined GDV of approximately Rs. 2,850 crore in Q3 FY27.

prior_guidance_check.quote: operating EBITDA was Rs. 35 crores, translating into EBITDA margin of 24%.

red_flags.label: Pre-sales moderated, down ~20% YoY
red_flags.quote: While pre-sales remained moderate amid evolving market dynamics

red_flags.label: Launch timing slipped; revenue down 45%
red_flags.quote: the new launches are shifted a couple of quarters.

red_flags.label: Competition rising in redevelopment
red_flags.quote: It has increased drastically in the last 12-18 months.

evasions.quote: So, we can stay positive for that, yes.
In terms of any specific question that you have, we can address that.
I think you have some wrong data point.

summary.headline: Arkade Q2 FY27 revenue fell to Rs. 145 crore with 24% EBITDA margin; pre-sales moderated to Rs. 151 crore amid no new launches.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue from operations was Rs. 145 crore, with operating EBITDA of Rs. 35 crore (24% margin) and PAT of Rs. 25 crore (17.14% PAT margin). Management attributed the year-on-year revenue decline to a high base from four projects that started revenue recognition in the prior-year quarter after crossing 25% construction. Collections grew 22% YoY to Rs. 183 crore, but pre-sales were moderate at Rs. 151 crore, with H1 pre-sales of Rs. 306 crore. The company added four Western Mumbai redevelopment projects (about 11 acres, Rs. 5,000 crore GDV) and targets two launches worth Rs. 2,850 crore in Q3 FY27.

financial_highlights.change: Down YoY; management cited high prior-year base, change % not stated in call (analyst cited 45.1% decline)
EBITDA margin 24%; described as broadly stable QoQ by analyst
Improved vs previous quarter per management
Analyst cited 20% YoY decline; management said flat QoQ

segments.name: Residential development (Mumbai/MMR)
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue Rs. 145 crore and H1 Rs. 292 crore; recognition lagged after a high prior-year base from four projects crossing 25% construction. Arkade Eden (Malad West) handed over and Arkade Pearl Phase 1 (Vile Parle) received OC ahead of RERA timeline.

guidance_outlook: Two launches with combined GDV of about Rs. 2,850 crore targeted in Q3 FY27; analyst-cited Rs. 600 crore figure for two launches was not corrected by management in the call.
Pre-sales target of about Rs. 1,000 crore for FY27 referenced by analyst; management said it can stay positive on exceeding Rs. 1,000 crore, with launches driving upside.
Thane Greenfield (Rs. 2,000 crore GDV) targeted for Q4 FY27 launch, subject to CC and RERA approval; to launch tower-wise over two years.
Filmistan project (analyst cited about Rs. 4,000 crore GDV) expected to launch next financial year per management; GDV raised on better rate realisation.
Pipeline GDV of about Rs. 19,000 crore across 5.7 million sq ft; launches planned over next 4-5 years.
Revenue recognition expected to improve in Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28 from recently launched Arkade Evoke (Bangur Nagar) and Arkade Sapphire (Santacruz).
capex_capacity: Projects are about 60-70% complete; around 30% of remaining construction cost yet to be incurred, per CFO.
About Rs. 70 crore spent on approvals for upcoming projects (Satya Shripal, Nutan Ayojan/Ascend), carried in inventory.
Four Western Mumbai redevelopments (Malad, Kandivali, Borivali; about 11 acres, 15 lakh sq ft saleable carpet area, Rs. 5,000 crore GDV) at preferred-developer stage, DA process pending.
Yogi Nagar DA finalised between lawyers; requires society SGM approvals before registration.
Thane project: LOI received, CC awaited, MOE in place; five towers on six acres.
Bhandup Woollen Mills MOU expected to complete in the next few months; South Bombay redevelopment in bidding (top developers in 79A voting).
demand_pricing: Management attributed moderate pre-sales to no new launches so far; existing projects have healthy demand and Q2 pre-sales were flat QoQ.
Realisations improved on existing projects, lifting gross margin to 35%; OC receipt added natural appreciation per management.
Analyst said pre-sales fell about 20% YoY; management did not dispute and pointed to launch timing.
Competition in Mumbai redevelopment has increased sharply in the last 12-18 months, per management.
Company has about 15 completed redevelopment projects over 15-20 years and 5-6 ongoing; bids selectively on location, size and GDV.

qa_highlights.question: Why were pre-sales moderate in H1 and what is the outlook for Q3 and Q4?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said moderation was company-specific because new launches were not yet out; Q2 pre-sales were flat QoQ and existing projects have healthy demand.

qa_highlights.question: What sales will the Q3 launches generate and how will they be executed?
qa_highlights.answer: Sales are planned against construction milestones over a 4-5 year project timeline, spread evenly across years; channel inquiries are good, with numbers to be released on launch.

qa_highlights.question: Reasons behind the reported delay at Arkade Rare?
qa_highlights.answer: Management disputed the delay, saying the RERA handover date was pre-poned from 28 December to 27 December.

qa_highlights.question: Is the company prepared to execute a large Filmistan project?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it has added manpower and onboarded architect, MEP, landscape consultants and execution contractors experienced in large projects.

qa_highlights.question: Will land acquisitions continue and is expansion limited to MMR?
qa_highlights.answer: Management pointed to the Bhandup MOU, a couple of other opportunities within 12 months, and said focus remains MMR; Navi Mumbai and South/North Mumbai proposals are being evaluated.

qa_highlights.question: Why did gross margin rise to 35% and what is the margin outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Higher realisations on existing projects and OC-driven appreciation at Arkade Eden and Arkade Pearl; management said construction cost increases are spread over 2-3 years, so impact is gradual.

risks_watch: Pre-sales run-rate of about Rs. 150 crore per quarter depends on the two Q3 launches; no new launches have been done in H1.
Revenue recognition gap: Q2 revenue down sharply YoY and recovery depends on Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28 construction milestones.
Execution scale-up for Filmistan and multiple redevelopments; management said no major challenges currently.
Rising competition in Mumbai redevelopment bidding over the last 12-18 months.
Several projects (Yogi Nagar, Western Mumbai redevelopments, Thane RERA, Bhandup) pending approvals or DA registration; timelines not fully committed.
Approx. Rs. 70 crore of approval costs sitting in inventory for upcoming projects.
summary.management_tone: Confident on pipeline, launches and execution, but cautious and deflective on pre-sales moderation and revenue decline, attributing them to launch timing and high prior base. Several answers on timelines were left open pending society approvals.
key_quotes: While pre-sales remained moderate amid evolving market dynamics, we continue to prioritize timely project delivery, customer confidence and operational efficiency as key drivers of sustainable business growth.
So, overall the timeline of these two projects are 4-5 years. And the sales will be evenly distributed across those four years.
We have pre-poned the RERA date in fact in Arkade Rare.

adds.what: Four Western Mumbai redevelopment projects (Malad, Kandivali, Borivali; ~11 acres, 15 lakh sq ft saleable carpet area, Rs. 5,000 crore GDV) at preferred-develop
Thane Greenfield project (Rs. 2,000 crore GDV, five towers on six acres) targeted for Q4 FY27 launch, subject to CC and RERA approval
Two launches with combined GDV ~Rs. 2,850 crore targeted in Q3 FY27

growth.why: No explicit revenue growth guidance; management targets two launches (~Rs. 2,850 crore GDV) in Q3 FY27 and Thane (Rs. 2,000 crore) in Q4 FY27, but these are launch/pre-sales pipeline rather than capacity, and the Western Mumbai redevelopments are still pending DA, so backing is only partial; Q2 revenue fell on a high prior-year base and pre-sales were flat QoQ.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Gross margin rose to 35% in Q2 (H1 32%) on higher realisations and OC-driven appreciation, but management says construction cost increases are spread over 2-3 years so the impact is gradual; Q2 EBITDA margin was 24% and H1 21.4%.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Two launches (~Rs. 2,850 crore GDV) targeted in Q3 FY27 and Thane (Rs. 2,000 crore GDV, five towers) in Q4 FY27, but Thane is subject to CC and RERA approval and Western Mumbai redevelopments are still pending DA, so timing is not fully committed.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Revenue fell YoY in Q2 to Rs. 145 crore (analyst cited 45% decline) on a high prior base; recovery depends on Arkade Evoke and Sapphire recognition from Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28, while pre-sales were Rs. 151 crore in Q2, flat QoQ, with no launches yet in H1.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Pipeline of about Rs. 19,000 crore GDV across 5.7 million sq ft and about Rs. 70 crore already spent on approvals for upcoming projects; Bhandup MOU expected to complete in the next few months and four Western Mumbai redevelopments at preferred-developer stage.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management says it can stay positive on exceeding the Rs. 1,000 crore FY27 pre-sales target, with launches driving upside; H1 pre-sales were Rs. 306 crore, so H2 needs about Rs. 694 crore, and the two Q3 launches (Rs. 2,850 crore GDV) are the main lever.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: H1 pre-sales of Rs. 306 crore leave the Rs. 1,000 crore FY27 target dependent on launches; revenue recognition gap and delay disputes (Arkade Rare) and pending approvals could slip timelines.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Two projects with combined GDV of about Rs. 2,850 crore are targeted for launch in Q3 FY27, and management says channel inquiries are good, though numbers are only released at launch.

rows.label: Western Mumbai redevelopment additions
rows.why: Four projects (~11 acres, 15 lakh sq ft, Rs. 5,000 crore GDV) are at preferred-developer stage with DA process pending, and Bhandup MOU expected in the next few months, so conversion is conditional.

rows.label: Collections strength
rows.why: Q2 collections grew 22% YoY to Rs. 183 crore and H1 collections Rs. 347 crore (+8% YoY), supporting cash generation while revenue recognition lags.

tone.note: Management was confident on the launch pipeline, Filmistan execution and collections, but cautious and deflective on pre-sales moderation, the Q2 revenue decline and the Arkade Rare delay. Analysts pressed on the pre-sales slowdown (cited ~20% YoY decline) and the revenue fall (cited 45%).
